title: PAC 278 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: PAC 278 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: PAC 278 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. 100 to 114 days to harvest, 7.5 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: PAC 278 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2024 as NSIC 2024 Cn 339. Advanta Seeds bred it. It takes 100 to 114 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.46 tonnes per hectare in the trials (9.68 in Luzon, 6.61 in the Visayas, 6.09 in Mindanao).

items: **Days to harvest:** 100 to 114 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 7.46 tonnes per hectare in the trials (9.68 in Luzon, 6.61 in the Visayas, 6.09 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

PAC 278 corn takes 100 to 114 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 4.2 days longer than the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.46 t/ha beats the average of its group, 7.17. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 17.21 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 79.76 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
Where and when to plant PAC 278 corn

It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Where can I buy seed of PAC 278?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
